lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Multiple rows of high-luminance, roughly circular clusters arranged in a staggered grid pattern posterior to the vertical gill slits. The spots are most densely clustered in the mid-flank area between the visible carinae.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Faint vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with the horizontal rows of circular spots, forming a series of anchor nodes that appear most distinct in the central third of the visible flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible running along the flank. Each is defined by a sharp vertical intensity gradient, with high luminance on the dorsal-facing edge and deep shadow on the ventral-facing edge.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex network of caustic light patterns caused by surface water refraction is superimposed across the entire visible dorsal and lateral surface, particularly intense near the uppermost visible ridge.
